wfcore.machine.radar.name: Radar
wfcore.machine.radar.tooltip: Finds enemy bases by clustering nearby machines and players. Needs sky access and Y >= 100. Requires EV power.
wfcore.machine.printer.tooltip: Prints a written report of bases found in radar scan data.
wfcore.machine.vehicle_factory.tooltip: Assembles a vehicle and deploys it in front of the factory. Recipes are programmable (KubeJS/GroovyScript); the recipe's output item is the vehicle.
